restoration_note: Teaching describes the First Man's redemptive descent: Divine Truth clothes itself in the elements, hands its 'lions-garment' (the dominion-zeal of the Living Soul) to the archons of death, who swallow it; the swallowed light becomes a hidden river of Judgment burning them from within. Short editor restorations (prepositions, conjunctions, idiom completions for ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗, ⲁⲃⲁⲗ, ⲫⲃⲥⲱ=ϩⲃⲥⲱ, ⲡⲕⲁϩ, ⲡⲣⲓⲅⲁⲥ=πέρας) are confirmed with high confidence. Larger interior lacunae in lines 47–59 and 64–81 carry visible structural traces (lions, body, archons, river, foundation) but the missing 5–11 character stretches are not constrained tightly enough by the surrounding Coptic to support a single reconstruction; honest non-restoration preserves the textual record.

restorations.basis: Editor's restoration of the temporal preposition ϩⲙ̄ before ⲡⲥⲏⲩ 'the time'; standard idiom 'in the time when.' Fits both grammar and the teaching's opening of the cosmic war.
Completes [ⲁ]ⲣⲉⲧϥ̄ in the standard idiom ⲧⲱⲕ ⲁⲣⲉⲧ⸗ 'stand fast (on his feet)' — the First Man's firm stance in ultimates against the Enmity.
Completes [ⲁⲩ]ⲱ 'and,' the standard conjunction continuing the parallel ⲁϩⲁϩⲉ ⲁⲣⲉⲧϩ 'he stood fast' from the prior line.
[ⲃⲁ]ⲗ completes the directional ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'forth' belonging to ⲥⲱⲣ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ 'spread forth (the strife)' from the previous line.
[ϩ]ⲃⲥⲱ = ϩⲃⲥⲱ 'garment' (lexicon: ⲍⲃⲥⲱ); the garment of the lions handed to the archons of death — the central image of the teaching.
Editor's restoration: perfect ⲁ + indefinite plural ϩⲛ̄ⲙⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉⲩⲉ 'lions' as subject of ⲱⲟⲩⲟ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ; the modifier ⲉⲛⲁⲱⲱⲟⲩ 'many' immediately follows. Fits the arc of the swallowed lions/Living Soul.

~7 chars before ⲓⲉⲣⲟ 'river.' Although a parallel formula ⲡⲓⲛⲁⲟ ⲛ̄/ⲡⲛⲁⲟ ⲛ̄ⲗⲉⲣⲟ exists, the line opening is too weakly constrained (article + qualifier; could equally be ⲟⲩⲛⲁⲟ ⲛ̄ or a different determiner). Honest non-restoration.
~11 chars with partial '...' and only 'there as bearers of destruction' as anchor. Subject (lions? archons? fire?) is undetermined; the spiritual sense fits multiple Coptic phrasings.
ⲁϥ-ϯ 'he gave' before ⲛⲉⲕⲉ 'others' — the giving-action continues the chain of donations (fire, wind, garment of lions) that the teaching narrates.
ⲉⲧⲉⲧⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲩ — relative imperfect 2pl 'that you saw,' standard form completing ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲩ. Master addressing disciples about the river of Judgment.
ⲁⲣⲁϥ — directional preposition ⲁⲣⲁ⸗ with 3sg masc suffix referring to the great river of Judgment.
~9 chars with partial 'ⲉ.ⲉ' and only the filling-image as context. Trace insufficient to constrain the subject phrase.
~3 chars + 'ⲙ' — 'seasons of {12}m'. Could be ⲣⲱⲕϩ (burning), ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲉ (year), ϣⲱⲙ (drought) or other; no single fill is constrained.
[ⲙ]ⲟⲩⲛ̄ϩⲱⲟⲩ — initial ⲙ for ⲙⲟⲩⲛ̄ϩⲱⲟⲩ 'downpour'; coheres with the teaching's image of dryness without rain.
~8 chars before 'of their days of being.' No anchoring trace.
[ⲙⲡ]ⲓ̈ⲉⲣⲟ 'of that river' — genitive linking with ⲧⲟⲁⲧ 'branch' from the previous line; standard formula ⲧⲟⲁⲧ ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲉⲣⲟ.
Single character at line end after ⲉ-; no constraint to choose between ⲡ-, ϫ-, ⲛ-, or other.
~11 chars opening a sentence about 'the body of the [archons/lions]'; opening verbal/nominal frame too unconstrained.
~5 chars in genitive position 'body of the {18}'. Could be ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ, ⲙⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉⲩⲉ, or other; insufficient trace.
~4 chars + 'ⲱⲛ' (could be ⲗⲉⲱⲛ, ⲁⲣⲭⲱⲛ, etc.) modifying the previous noun phrase; trace too small to discriminate.
~10 chars before 'the lions'; opening of new sentence with no constraining anchor.
~2 chars between 'the lions' and damaged 'now'; no trace.
~3 chars opening clause '{22} there is the first'; could be article+demonstrative (ⲡⲏ, ⲧⲏ, ⲡⲁⲓ̈) but undetermined.
~5 chars feminine noun 'the first {23}.' Spiritual arc points to Enmity (ⲙⲛⲧⲭⲁⲭⲉ, 8 chars — too long) or another feminine principle; length doesn't fit. Unrestorable.
ϩ[ⲙ] — restoration of ⲙ for the locative preposition ϩⲙ̄ 'in.'
~7 chars with partial 'ⲉϩⲁ'; trace position is unclear and no parallel formula yields a unique fill.
[ⲛ̄ⲣ]ⲓⲅⲁⲥ — restoration giving ⲛ̄ⲣⲓⲅⲁⲥ (Greek πέρας 'boundary'); the mighty boundary holding the offspring of the prison fits the stronghold-state image.
~9 chars with bare partial 'ⲣ'; too weak to constrain a fill.
~2 chars before ⲉⲧⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'which are manifest'; could be ⲛⲉⲧ-, ⲁⲩ-, or relative particle; no trace to discriminate.
~4 chars; pronoun or demonstrative for 'all of them shall cease' — could be ⲛⲁⲓ̈, ⲛⲉⲩ-, ⲛ̄ϩⲁⲧ-; undetermined.
~3 chars connecting 'cease' with 'a last' — adverbial particle indeterminable.
~2 chars opening clause; no trace.
~2 chars after 'reckoned to'; directional/possessive too weakly constrained.
ⲡⲕⲁ[ϩ] 'the earth' — the river of Judgment that exists upon the earth (the visible smallest branch of the hidden judgment-river).
~6 chars with partial 'ⲛⲧⲉ'; could be many phrasings ('ⲡⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲧⲉ' or attributive) — no single secure fill.
ⲉⲧ[ⲙ̄ⲙⲉⲩ] 'that one (there)' — standard demonstrative completing the doxology 'How great is that god there.'
~7 chars at line end; doxological clause is too open-ended to constrain.

~6 chars after 'First Man who'; spiritual sense (who wore the elements / silver garments) is clear but the exact verbal phrase (ⲁϩⲣ̄ⲫⲟⲣⲉ or related) does not match the 6-char count snugly. Better unrestored.
